01
Product Deconstruction & CAD Reconstruction
Anko Bluetooth Speaker

This project focused on the deconstruction and analysis of a small Bluetooth speaker to gain an understanding of its manufacturing and assembly processes. These findings informed a detailed evaluation of the speaker's design and supported the accurate recreation of the product through CAD modelling.

SolidWorks KeyShot Sketching Photoshop InDesign
Deconstruction & Components Analysis

The teardown documented the fastening methods and spatial arrangement of the PCB, drivers, and housing. Draft angles and ejector pin marks confirmed the product was optimised for high-volume injection-moulded tooling.

CAD Construction & Assembly

Every component was reconstructed in SolidWorks from measurements taken during teardown, letting the digital model reflect the physical one while surfacing manufacturing features and part relationships.

02
User Experience & Interaction
Mid Century Modern Lamp

This project focused on creating an intuitive and experimental lighting product given a theme, with the focus on a tangible user interaction that drives a specific experience through mechanical, electronic, or physical means.

SolidWorks KeyShot Sketching Photoshop InDesign
Colour, Material & Finish

The CMF strategy draws from the warm, earthy tones of the 1950s and 60s — pairing walnut with orange and white, plus brass and opal glass for a premium, softly diffused glow.

Prototyping

Built through hands-on fabrication combining shaped wood and formed acrylic. Iterative testing refined the form, assembly, and integration of electronics into a functional, cohesive object.

03
Product Redesign & Concept Ideation
BMW M8 Engine Cover Redesign

This project required redesigning the current BMW M8 Competition engine cover, reimagining it through the theme of Digital Design — balancing BMW's motorsport graphic identity with the aesthetics of digital hardware.

SolidWorks KeyShot Sketching Photoshop InDesign
Design Language & Analysis

Analysis across BMW M models surfaced consistent principles — repeated trapezoidal forms, vertical orientation, and carbon-fibre sections — preserved here to keep the redesign legible as BMW.

In Context

Matte finishes, textures, and surfaces build a high-end, refined aesthetic that blends seamlessly into the engine bay while reinforcing the M8 Competition's performance identity.

04
Concept Ideation & User Experience
Mini Scooter Concept

An exploration of a personal transportation vehicle with close consideration of ergonomics, human factors, and human-machine interaction. The challenge was translating MINI's automotive personality into a micromobility vehicle.

SolidWorks KeyShot Sketching Photoshop InDesign
Ideation

Underlay sketching kept MINI's design language close throughout, exploring several directions before tutor feedback narrowed the field to one concept — refined for transportability, form, and function.

Prototyping

Small-scale FDM prints allowed quick ergonomic assessment before the final form was sanded, primed, and painted to represent the chosen CMF strategy.

About

About Me

I am a fourth-year Industrial Design student at the Queensland University of Technology, originally from Brazil. I am driven by a curiosity for how products are made and how they can be improved, with a focus on user experience, attention to detail, innovation, and sustainability.

My work spans the full design process, from research and sketching to detailed CAD modelling, prototyping, and rendering. I aim to create products that are purposeful, intuitive, and manufacturable, balancing creative thinking with technical execution.

From a young age, I have been passionate about making and creating, which continues to shape my approach to design today.
